routes.name: Complete compressed graph reduction from reviewed exact projection
Universal exact projection through small supports and componentwise gauge gluing

C9000133.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 133 (The computational complexity of Weisfeiler–Leman refinement.; papers: Parity lifts and bounded-treewidth witnesses for Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence; The complexity of identifying a graph by Weisfeiler–Leman refinement; Unconditional time lower bounds for Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence; Variable-dimension Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence on general and subcubic graphs; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/133.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

P_MAIN.statement: Parity manuscript thm:eth: positive-rate ETH implies a linear-in-dimension exponent lower bound for both WL conventions.

P_REDUCTION.statement: Parity manuscript thm:choice-reduction: successful compatible choices exactly distinguish the parity-lift pair, with the stated order and early-round bounds.

P_DUALITY.statement: Parity manuscript lem:lift-duality and lem:choice-witness, using the cited dual obstruction theorem.

P_SEPARATOR.statement: Parity manuscript lem:extract-choice, using the cited bounded-treewidth separator argument.

P_HOM.statement: Parity manuscript lem:hom-implies-wl and lem:test-detected, including the cited homomorphism characterization.

P_SAT.statement: Parity manuscript lem:sparsification and lem:sat-choice; positive-rate ETH is an external hypothesis, not verified here.

I_MAIN.statement: Identification manuscript thm:main: EXPTIME-completeness for binary and unary dimension.

I_MATE.statement: Identification manuscript prop:mate: normalization of every equivalent mate to G(beta).

I_IMAGES.statement: Identification manuscript prop:image-consistency: equivalent mates satisfy local image equalities.

I_TWIST.statement: Identification manuscript thm:special-twist: lift special twists by compatible offsets.

I_DECISION.statement: Identification manuscript prop:acceptance and prop:rejection, including computation, global-offset and isomorphism obligations.

F_MAIN.statement: Fixed-dimension manuscript main unconditional n^(c k) lower bounds, for the stated sequential models and both conventions.

F_REDUCTION.statement: Fixed-dimension manuscript comp:reduction: compressed consistency/game equivalence, graph size and padding.

CR.statement: Universal comp:reduction on the actual uncolored owner-mark graphs with hub, every equal padding count, both game directions, and explicit unpadded O(m^6) order. Kernel certified; independent statement-fidelity and game-convention review remains.

CR_TIMING.statement: Separate extensions of one retained offset list yield a single preannounced vertex bijection, not a vertex-dependent response.

CR_RINGS.statement: All-history ring transfers in both directions recover equality of the individual scalar images without a memoryless-strategy or global-solution assumption.

CR_MARKS.statement: Degree recognition and owner activation transport the equivalence to the actual uncolored graphs for every padding count.

CR_SIZE.statement: The explicit block, valuation, and private-mark construction has O(m^2) blocks and unpadded order O(m^6) for fixed description shape.

CR_WL.statement: The game's announced-bijection convention corresponds to joint r-WL and separate (r+1)-WL, with the exact parameter shift.

F_CIRCUIT.statement: Fixed-dimension manuscript circ:simulation and circ:computation with their time/address inequalities.

F_DIAGONAL.statement: Fixed-dimension manuscript diag:simulation and diag:language; the cited simulation model still requires an independent literature audit outside this bounded mission.

V_MAIN.statement: Variable-dimension manuscript thm:main: general and connected-subcubic EXPTIME-completeness.

V_COMPUTATION.statement: Variable-dimension manuscript prop:computation and prop:consistency, including companion compiler.

V_GAME.statement: Variable-dimension manuscript prop:game-reduction and its general/subcubic game corollaries.

EP.statement: Universal nonempty compatible affine-offset families with exact restriction for every retained list and every V subset U, |U|<=r+1. Kernel certified; graph closure awaits independent statement-fidelity review.

EP_SUPPORT.statement: offset:lem-support / comp:support: small component supports are trees with at most one real type.

EP_WRAP.statement: offset:lem-wrapping / comp:wrapping: wrapping requires r blocks and r-block witnesses recover the same allowed aligned address.

EP_SHIFTS.statement: offset:lem-shifts-exist and offset:lem-wrapping-lift: nonempty admissible shifts and onto restriction to a retained wrapping component.

EP_GAUGE.statement: offset:lem-gauge: every change of shifts on a nonwrapping component is absorbed while preserving all old readouts.

EP_GLUE.statement: Every selected retained list extends by independent potential changes on old corner components, including merging components.

EP_TESTS.statement: Bounded exact extension tests are finite experiments, not universal proofs.

EP_SOURCE.statement: Upstream ExactProjection.lean is source-level prior evidence only until local kernel checking and statement-fidelity review.
